SELECT roleName, roleNo, roleLevel FROM ( SELECT v.role_name AS roleName, MIN(r.role_no) AS roleNo, v.role_level AS roleLevel FROM ( SELECT '최고운영자' AS role_name, 99 AS role_level FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '운영관리자' AS role_name, 98 AS role_level FROM DUAL ) v LEFT JOIN ROLE r ON r.company_no = #{companyNo} AND r.role_level = v.role_level GROUP BY v.role_name, v.role_level
UNION ALL
SELECT role_name AS roleName, MIN(role_no) AS roleNo, role_level AS roleLevel FROM ROLE WHERE company_no = #{companyNo} AND role_level NOT IN (98, 99) GROUP BY role_name, role_level ) ORDER BY roleLevel DESC

SELECT r.role_no AS roleNo, r.role_name AS roleName, r.user_no AS userNo, r.role_level AS roleLevel, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email, p.position_name AS position, k.rank_name AS rank FROM ROLE r JOIN USERS u ON r.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN TITLE t ON u.user_no = t.user_no LEFT JOIN POSITION p ON t.position_no = p.position_no LEFT JOIN RANK k ON t.rank_no = k.rank_no WHERE r.company_no = #{companyNo} AND r.role_level = #{roleLevel} AND r.user_no IS NOT NULL

mapper.delete: delete from role where role_no=#{roleNo} and company_no=#{companyNo}
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_no AS roleNo, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_level AS roleLevel, r.company_no AS companyNo, r.user_no AS userNo, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email FROM ROLE r JOIN USERS u ON r.user_no = u.user_no WHERE r.company_no = #{companyNo} AND r.role_level = 99 AND r.user_no IS NOT NULL
SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email FROM USERS u WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo} AND u.company_no = #{companyNo}

SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email, p.position_name AS position, r.rank_name AS rank FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN TITLE t ON u.user_no = t.user_no LEFT JOIN POSITION p ON t.position_no = p.position_no LEFT JOIN RANK r ON t.rank_no = r.rank_no WHERE u.company_no = #{companyNo} AND ( u.user_id = #{keyword} OR u.user_name = #{keyword, typeHandler=kr.co.sist.login.EncryptTypeHandler} ) ORDER BY u.user_name, u.user_id
